description.content: Body JSON duoc dung dong trong pre-request script tu iteration data.

Bo kich ban kiem thu tu dong (data-driven) cho API POST /api/apply-coupon cua eshop-sut.

- SUT: backend/server.js (Express + SQLite), port 3000
- Chay bang Collection Runner hoac Newman voi --iteration-data mini-apply-coupon.data.json (5 iteration)
- Moi assertion deu doc gia tri ky vong tu iteration data (expected_status, expected_discount_amount, ...) nen cung 1 request phuc vu ca positive, negative va boundary case.
- Tien to test: 'Functional:' = hanh vi nghiep vu, 'Contract:' = schema/kieu du lieu, 'Regression-lock:' = khoa hanh vi sai da biet (BUG-01/BUG-02).

MSSV: 23127178

- 200: { success, coupon_id, discount_amount, final_amount, message }
- 400: thieu code / don chua du min_order_amount / ma het han / vuot max_uses_per_user
- 404: ma khong ton tai hoac is_active = 0
